title: How to Have Impossible Conversations (Long Listen)
desc: Why do some conversations feel impossible, and what does research say about making them better? A calm, sourced long listen about the illusion of being clear, the gap between us and them, what good listening does, the power of follow-up questions, the words that keep people talking, how fights begin, what happens in the body when we are flooded, whether anyone can change a mind, why explaining beats arguing, the backfire myth, speaking another person's values, contact between groups, how to apologise and forgive, when to stop and stay safe, and a toolkit you can use. It ends with a slow wind-down for sleep. Every claim comes from named studies, and the doubts are left in.
